accounts_card_days.name: accounts_card_days
accounts_card_days.value: "accounts"."kind" <> 'credit_card' or ("accounts"."closing_day" is not null and "accounts"."due_day" is not null)

investment_movements_tax.name: investment_movements_tax
investment_movements_tax.value: ("investment_movements"."kind" = 'withdrawal' or "investment_movements"."tax_cents" is null) and coalesce("investment_movements"."tax_cents", 0) between 0 and "investment_movements"."amount_cents"

investments_fixed_rate.name: investments_fixed_rate
investments_fixed_rate.value: ("investments"."yield_kind" = 'fixed') = ("investments"."fixed_rate_ppm" is not null) and coalesce("investments"."fixed_rate_ppm", 0) between 0 and 100000

investments_cdi_share.name: investments_cdi_share
investments_cdi_share.value: ("investments"."yield_kind" = 'cdi') = ("investments"."cdi_share_bp" is not null) and coalesce("investments"."cdi_share_bp", 1) between 1 and 30000

investments_goal.name: investments_goal
investments_goal.value: "investments"."goal_month" is null or "investments"."goal_cents" is not null
